limitations: Table 7 gives 17 numeric gamma(MoO3) values spanning 0.027 (CAS2) to 1.64 (MAS2), with one-sigma errors; Table 8 supplies the composition terms rather than a constant coefficient.

Table 8 prints log10(gamma) coefficients; the stored natural-log coefficients are multiplied by ln(10). The CMAS mole fractions count two AlO1.5 units per Al2O3 formula and exclude TiO2 from the CMAS denominator.

The 0.127849985460 ln(gamma) closure RMS is calculated from the 17 Table 7 central values and the Table 8 law evaluated at the corresponding Table 1 mean compositions; Table 1 does not report individual Table 7 sample compositions.
The composition windows are the marginal Table 1 mean-composition ranges for the melt names with numeric Table 7 MoO3 values; they do not define a jointly sampled continuous CMAS hull.
The activity coefficient is relative to pure liquid MoO3 as defined by the source; the shipped Mo-015 liquid row supplies the corresponding pure-liquid oxide thermochemistry.
